title: Add BC performance knowledge from OptimAL learnings
summary: Adds six performance knowledge articles with paired good and bad AL examples on workload-based and overlapping indexes, buffered inserts, aggregate-before-write, scoped reuse and repeated validation. Refines existing guidance on partial loads, temporary buffers, bulk updates, existence checks, primary-key caching and FlowField versus stored totals.
key_points: Six new articles on workload-based keys, overlapping indexes, buffered inserts, aggregate-before-write, scoped result reuse and repeated validation
Each new article has paired good and bad AL examples
Existing guidance refined for partial loads, temporary buffers, bulk updates, existence checks, primary-key caching and FlowField versus stored-field totals
Performance-review retrieval and evaluation fixtures extended for the new rules
